title: Split, Spawn, Join
prompt: Implement `parallelSum`: split [0, n) into nThreads contiguous chunks, sum each chunk on its own std::thread into a shared atomic, join everything, return the total.

tests.name: even split sums exactly
tests.hint: Chunk [lo, hi) per thread: lo = i * n / nThreads, hi = (i+1) * n / nThreads — the rounding splits contiguously without gaps or overlap.

tests.name: more threads than elements
tests.hint: Empty chunks (lo == hi) must simply add 0 — never spawn on an empty range or guard the loop.
